page_title: ACM 1-1 CAG | AC Milan v Cagliari 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
90+6' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Elia Caprile, who denies him with a terrific save.
90+6' AC Milan quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
90+5' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle after Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. AC Milan earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+3' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
90+1' That's a clear yellow card. Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) goes into the book.
90+1' Flag up against Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) heads on.
88' Rafael Leao comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bob Omoregbe (AC Milan).
86' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 21:5.
82' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' Substitution. Antoine Makoumbou leaves the pitch and is replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
81' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is substituted due to injury. Davide Nicola gives a chance to Tommaso Augello.
78' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) meets a cross from Alejandro Jimenez, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
78' Davide Nicola is forced to make a change. Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mateusz Wieteska.
77' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
75' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to find Christian Pulisic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
74' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
71' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
70' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
68' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
67' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
67' Elia Caprile blocks Theo Hernandez (AC Milan)'s effort from the edge of the box.
66' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
65' The game is interrupted now, Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' It is time for a substitution. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is on for Nicolas Viola.
63' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a change. Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) replaces Davide Calabria.
62' That will be all from Yunus Musah who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
62' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
62' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

61' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
60' 13:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
57' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
57' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Elia Caprile easily deals with the threat.

55' 1 - 1 Goal! Mattia Felici sets up Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
53' The linesman signals that Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.

51' This was a nice effort by both teams. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) connected with a cross from the side and slammed it straight towards the right side of the target. Elia Caprile leapt like a salmon and tipped the ball onto the post.
51' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Elia Caprile is alert and denies him with a nice save.
47' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
47' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' Flag goes up against Yunus Musah (AC Milan) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
42' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mattia Felici (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
40' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Maignan makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
38' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
37' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
35' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
34' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
33' 6:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
30' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
29' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

27' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francesco Fourneau with no other option than to blow for a foul.
26' Adam Obert (Cagliari) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
24' The game is interrupted as Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is flagged offside.
23' Some great controlled play and passing from AC Milan. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
20' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save.
18' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
18' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
15' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
14' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
14' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
12' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
9' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Elia Caprile makes a comfortable save.

7' Ambitious effort from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
6' A spell of possession for AC Milan in an attempt to control the game.
3' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle and it's Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) works the corner short.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau is introduced as the referee for today's match.
